name: Andorra
tagline: A Pyrenean co-principality with two heads of state, no airport, and the highest capital in Europe.
summary: Andorra is 468 square kilometres of Pyrenean valley, jointly headed by the President of France and a Spanish bishop — an arrangement running since 1278. Catalan is the official language. It is best known for duty-free shopping and skiing, and least known for Romanesque chapels and a genuinely wild high valley on the UNESCO list.

season.note: Two clear seasons: skiing from December to April, and high walking from late June to September. May and October are between them and much of the mountain infrastructure shuts.

getting_around: No airport and no railway. Buses run from Barcelona, Toulouse and the French rail station at L'Hospitalet. Inside the country, buses go up every valley.
food: Trinxat: cabbage, potato and bacon, mountain winter food
Cheese and charcuterie from the valley farms, and Pyrenean lamb

festivals.name: Andorra la Vella winter sports season

know: Not in the EU or Schengen, but there are no routine border controls with France or Spain; customs limits are enforced.
Fuel, alcohol and electronics are cheaper here, which is why the main road is a queue on Saturdays.
The Madriu-Perafita-Claror valley has no road at all and is entered on foot.

regions.name: The Valleys
regions.summary: The capital in the deepest valley, ski country above, and a roadless UNESCO valley to the southeast.

cities.name: Andorra la Vella
cities.summary: Europe's highest capital at 1,023 metres, in a narrow valley, mostly shops with mountains directly behind them.
highlights: Casa de la Vall, the 16th-century parliament house
Caldea thermal spa, fed by hot springs
Ski areas twenty minutes up the valley in either direction

cities.name: Madriu-Perafita-Claror
cities.summary: A glacial valley with no road into it, on the UNESCO list for a cultural landscape of summer pasture and stone huts.
highlights: Nine per cent of the country, entered only on foot
Shepherds' bordes and dry-stone terraces still standing
Refuges with no booking and no warden

experiences.name: Into the roadless valley
experiences.summary: Six hours in from Escaldes; the only sounds are water and cowbells, and the huts are open and free.
